adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the old code created the first post via `PostCreator.new(..., created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]), ...)`, explicitly preserving the Disqus thread date. The new code replaces that with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and neither `TopicEmbed.import_remote` nor `TopicEmbed.import` passes/sets `created_at` when calling `PostCreator.new(...)`. Therefore imported topics/posts will default to the current import time, changing behavior and producing incorrect timestamps for Disqus imports.
